data.credibility: Management generally delivers or raises targets when visible, but drops long-term commitments such as the five-year shareholder return pledge without updating progress in later quarters.

lines.line: Raised FY26 Services revenue growth guidance to 4%-5% and successfully delivered.
Kept company-level guidance at 3%-5% constant currency, ultimately delivered.
Promised FY27 EBIT margin of 17%-18%, actual reached 20.5%.
Guided FY27 revenue growth to 1%-4%, currently on track after a raise.
Guided FY27 Services growth to 1.5%-4.5%, currently on track following a raise.
Guided FY27 EBIT margin of 17.5%-18.5%, tracking at 20.4% so far.
Promised at least 75% net income return over 5 years, dropped due to missing mentions.

overrides.reason: Management stopped mentioning the target in subsequent quarters without tracking updates.

bull: Revenue compounded 11.5% annually over 5 years, accompanied by strong net new deal wins of $9.3 billion in FY26.
The company is virtually debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08, backed by robust operating cash flow at 127% of profit.
Working-capital days significantly improved, tightening from 48 down to 23 over the past five years.
bear: EBITDA margin narrowed considerably from 26.6% in FY21 down to 20.6% in FY26.
Growth is visibly slowing, dropping to 8.7% annually over the last three years compared to 11.5% over five years.
Management dropped its multi-year 75% shareholder return commitment after failing to report on it in consecutive quarters.
